logger.doc:name: Log Poll Timeout
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "error" var msg = "IDP Subscriber - TIMEOUT: Execution exceeded max poll attempts (" ++ p('idp.action.max_checks') ++ ") for file: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.documentLibrary default 'unknown') ++ ")" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: {documentLibrary: vars.documentLibrary, executionId: vars.executionId, fileName: vars.fileName, pollCount: vars.pollCount, maxChecks: p('idp.action.max_checks')}) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]

set-variable.value: #[((payload.documentName default vars.fileName) as String) replace /\.[^.]*$/ with '']

logger.doc:name: Log Success
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "ok" var msg = "IDP Subscriber - SUCCESS: File " ++ vars.fileName ++ " (library: " ++ vars.documentLibrary ++ ") processed successfully and CSV written to Output folder" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: {documentLibrary: vars.documentLibrary, fileName: vars.fileName, csvFile: 'idp-results-' ++ vars.outputBaseName ++ '.csv', executionId: vars.executionId}) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]

logger.doc:name: Log IDP Failed
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "error" var msg = "IDP Subscriber - FAILED: IDP reported execution status as FAILED for file: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.documentLibrary default 'unknown') ++ ")" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: {documentLibrary: vars.documentLibrary, executionId: vars.executionId, fileName: vars.fileName, idpStatus: payload.status}) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]

logger.doc:name: Log Still Processing
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "ok" var msg = "IDP Subscriber - PROCESSING: Execution still in progress for file: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.documentLibrary default 'unknown') ++ "), requeueing for next poll cycle" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: {documentLibrary: vars.documentLibrary, executionId: vars.executionId, fileName: vars.fileName, idpStatus: payload.status, pollCount: vars.pollCount}) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { executionId: vars.executionId, fileName: vars.fileName, documentLibrary: vars.documentLibrary, processingUrl: vars.processingUrl, outputPath: vars.outputPath, processedPath: vars.processedPath, errorPath: vars.errorPath, pollCount: (vars.pollCount as Number) + 1 }

logger.doc:name: Log Subscriber Failure
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "error" var msg = "IDP Subscriber - ERROR: Unexpected error in subscriber flow for file: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.documentLibrary default 'unknown') ++ ")" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: {documentLibrary: vars.documentLibrary, executionId: vars.executionId, fileName: vars.fileName, errorType: error.errorType.identifier, errorDescription: error.description}) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]

logger.doc:name: Log Move-to-Error Failure
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "warning" var msg = "IDP Subscriber - WARNING: Could not move failed file to Error folder: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.documentLibrary default 'unknown') ++ ")" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, env: p('mule.env') })]
